Sakshi B. Wandhare Strategic Partnerships | Enterprise Sales | Channel Growth

Hyderabad, Telangana, India | +91 70219 38171 | wandharesakshi86@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/sakshi-w-04a6721ab

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Customer Growth, Account Management, and Channel Partnerships professional with 4.5+ years of experience driving global B2B revenue, partner ecosystem growth, and go-to-market execution across SaaS, iPaaS, FinTech, EdTech, and IT consulting sectors. Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets by building scalable partner pipelines and executing data-driven GTM strategies across US, UK, EU, and APAC markets.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Channel Sales Manager (Partnerships & Strategic Alliances) AppSeConnect – Hyderabad, India

Jun 2025 – Present

Managed a 300+ partner ecosystem across CRM, ERP, and eCommerce verticals in US, UK, EU, Australia, and Dubai through targeted account research, opportunity mapping, and structured outreach.

Generated $30K–$50K+ in partner-sourced revenue per quarter through structured demos, proposals, and follow- ups across reseller and referral partner segments.

Managed end-to-end partner lifecycle, onboarding to retention, achieving 40-60% activation rates through structured partner enablement programs.

Drove partner marketing across email, LinkedIn, blogs, and webinars (Instantly, HeyReach), improving email engagement by 30% and partner engagement by 25–40%.



Co-led GTM launch of new product appse ai — an ERP-native AI workflow automation platform, owning partner program structuring, pricing strategy, and adoption through automation demos and AI use-case development.

Built AI-driven workflow automations for the marketing and partnerships function using Claude, ChatGPT, reducing manual effort across outreach, reporting, and lead management.

Senior Business Development Executive Fuse Capital – Hyderabad, India

Apr 2024 – May 2025



Spearheaded lead generation and market outreach across the UK using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, Apollo.io, and Lusha.



Executed multi-touch email campaigns via HubSpot CRM, increasing client engagement by 40%.

Managed the end-to-end sales pipeline, including lead qualification, discovery calls, and client onboarding. • Led global event marketing and outbound prospecting campaigns, contributing to Q4 revenue targets across UK markets.

Optimized campaign tracking and project management using Monday.com, boosting LinkedIn engagement by 30%.

Marketing Associate MyGreenHorn – Bangalore, India

Nov 2022 – Mar 2024

Managed the complete B2B sales cycle from prospecting and outreach to proposal management, negotiations, onboarding, and customer success, consistently achieving 95% of lead generation targets.



Led digital marketing initiatives, including SEO keyword research, content strategy and management for LinkedIn and Instagram, and coordinated webinars with the Co-founder, increasing brand awareness by 30%.



Contributed to a 25% revenue increase in 2023 by implementing sales enablement initiatives, optimizing lead conversion strategies, and supporting business growth.

Built and maintained strong client relationships, ensuring high customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.

HR & Marketing Executive Jan 2022 – Sep 2022 Percept Infosystem – Nagpur, India

Managed IT and non-IT recruitment, achieving a 95% hiring success rate. • Generated ₹10L+ in revenue within 7 months through B2B business development. • Strengthened client relationships to enhance retention and satisfaction.

KEY SKILLS



Core Competencies: Client Account Management, Strategic Partnerships, Customer Growth, Stakeholder Management, Account Planning, Relationship Management, Business Development, Market Research, Competitive Intelligence, Cross-functional Collaboration

Account Management & Operations: Account Portfolio Management, CRM Management, Pipeline Management, Opportunity Mapping, Customer Success, Client Retention, Business Reviews, Revenue Growth Planning, Account Research



Tools & Platforms: HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Instantly, HeyReach, Mailchimp, Lusha, Claude AI, Monday.com, n8n Automation, Canva, Microsoft Office

EDUCATION

PGDM in Marketing & Business Analytics ISBR Business School, Bangalore • Gold Medalist, Marketing Specialization • GEM’s Academic Award recipient • Capstone Project: Applied pivot tables and Tableau to optimize customer feedback analytics for AI product

2022 – 2024

development

B.Sc. in Physics & Mathematics Hislop College, Nagpur

2018 – 2021

H.S.C. in PCMB St. Xavier’s College, Mumbai

2018

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING

Marketing Analytics – University of Virginia (Coursera), Score: 93% • Business Analytics – WEKA Software • Marketing Automation – Udemy • Marketing Research Training – Infosys Springboard • Generative AI for Marketing – APPSeCONNECT

AWARDS & LEADERSHIP

Most Innovative Employee Award – UK at Fuse Capital (2024) • Best Performer Award – MyGreenHorn (Aug 2023) • President, Women’s Studies & Development Cell – Hislop College (2020–2021)
